CRS’s work for Cadbury defending the Cadbury Purple trademark stood out as a creative use of legal skill to protect brand identity in a difficult commercial setting. Advising art and luxury clients appeals for the same intellectually demanding, commercially alive reasons.

Values alignment matters as much as practice fit. Innovation such as webcam pro bono clinics during the pandemic further evidences a forward-looking ethos I want to join.

As an international firm, CRS offers cross-border matters and a collaborative platform; that prospect is genuinely exciting. I prefer the London office because it sits at the centre of the firm’s international operations and concentrates the family and art work that most interests me. CRS therefore provides the right setting to build skill while contributing to meaningful client work.
